spec.name: hypermem_everme_memory_patterns
spec.purpose: Three-level hierarchical memory index with coarse-to-fine retrieval, routed sparse pack lookup, and versioned plugin contracts

summary: Patterns from EverMind-AI/HyperMem (Apache-2.0), EverMind-AI/EverMe (Apache-2.0) and EverMind-AI/MSA (ideas only — no LICENSE file): a three-level topic→episode→fact memory index with same-level weighted grouping links and coarse-to-fine top-down retrieval; routed sparse lookup that scores small per-pack routing keys and loads only selected packs; a versioned public-contracts note for the HALEX-AI plugin surface; Memory Interleave as a drafter rule for multi-pack questions. All restated in our own words, stdlib-only, no provider/network/API-key/server/MCP/GPU/model-weight code.
